# External data

- `UNRATE.csv`: US civilian unemployment rate, monthly, seasonally adjusted, 2006-01 to 2024-12.
  Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), series `UNRATE`,
  downloaded from `https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=UNRATE` on 2026-11-09.
  Used only by the Phase 2 level experiments (`src/survival_level.py`).
